title: Last Day of Fable - Help Megathread?
author: --Clintoris--
selftext:
Since we all basically only have 24 hours of Fable left, let's drop our game in comments and people can give suggestions on what to update with their last day of Fable access.  

An outsider perspective is important and is more valuable today than tomorrow

comments.author: --Clintoris--
comments.body:
[Dugout-Dice.com](http://Dugout-Dice.com)

Anything UI related that looks bad or needs changing?

replies.author: brother_spirit
replies.body:
Looks cool.   
The left/right spread feels a bit "extreme". They seem to be purely visual so I would suggests removing.

Also you've got some "modern" fonts and "8-bit" fonts living under the same roof. Pick a style and run with it (the 8bit looks cool to me).

Button "hover" and "press" has a very minor "twitch" where it jumps the last key frame to settle after the animation. Probably just needs a bit of smoothing and it will work fine.

replies.body: Amazing thanks! This is super helpful

comments.body: I switched to gpt5.5 xhigh once i blew my fable out, and strangely, it doesnt seem to be performing that much different. comments.author: Outrageous_Band9708
comments.body:
If you have usage left to burn. Put it on max plan mode and ask it to do a full audit of your source and recommend things. 
Create plans and roadmaps. A large idea you’ve been sitting on. Discuss it and then have it output a plan for you
